Report Verbs with Impersonal Passive Constructions
When you want to avoid saying the generalized agent (they, people, everybody etc.) of an action, you can use report verbs such as claim, mention, request, and point out with a passive structure.
You can use the structure: subject + passive reporting verb + to-infinitive

In this pattern you start with the subject of the reported clause (my brother), which is followed by the passive reporting verb (known) and the to-infinitive form of the verb (to like) in the reported clause.

Everybody knows that my brother likes watching football =
My brother is known to like watching football.
Notice that the reporting verb (to know) is in the same tense (present) in both sentences.

Modals for Expressing Duty and Advice: Had Better
You can use the modal phrase had better to express what is the best thing to do in a particular situation.
You're very busy. You had better ask for some help in order to complete your assignment on time.
Had better is stronger in meaning than should/ought to, but it is not as strong as must.
The negative is had better not.
We'd better not delay the delivery of this project.

images.text: In any organization, managers are said to perform many tasks and play many roles. It is believed that they are responsible for handling many situations. When it comes to handling situations, managers use their own management styles. Some management styles had better be used in some situations and some had better not be used. There are four main management styles considered to be practiced by managers all over the world.

Autocratic
</br>In this management style, the manager is understood to be the sole decision-maker. The decisions made reflect the personality and the opinion of the manager rather than the team's collective opinion. If the manager has a great personality, experience and exposure, the decisions made could be better than collective decision-making.</br></br>Democratic
</br>In this style, the manager is open to others' opinions and welcomes their contribution into the decision-making process. Therefore, every decision is made with the majority's agreement. The decisions reflect the team's opinion. For this management style to work successfully, there had better be robust communication between the manager and the team. This type of management is most successful when it comes to decision-making on a complex matter. Before making a decision, there is usually a series of meetings that take place. These meetings had better be properly planned and documented. Due to the collective nature, this style of management gives more employee satisfaction.

Paternalistic
</br>This is claimed to be a dictatorial type of management. The decisions made are usually for the best interest of the company as well as the employees. When the manager makes a decision, it is explained to the employees and obtains their support as well. In this management style, work-life balance is emphasized which is proved to maintain a high morale within the organization.</br></br>Laissez-faire
</br>In this type of management, the manager is observed to be a facilitator for the staff. The employees take the responsibility of different areas of their work. When the employee faces an obstacle, the manager had better intervene and remove it. In this style, the employee is more independent and owns his or her responsibilities.
